subject: Whole DKC soundtrack study and original instrumentation priority
question: How should soundtrack instrumentation be researched and reconciled with the existing musician collective?
decision: Build a separate entire-soundtrack DKC profile: locate original YouTube recordings and MIDI backings first, then map all audible instruments to available files and stress-test their closeness. In-game instrumentation always wins a conflict with the musician roster; the roster must never restrict the study. Record missing sources, instruments and articulations in the master audit. This research commission does not accept any unheard match or authorize runtime replacement.
